newsitem.title: USA: SAKAKIBARA SAYS DISCUSSED "WIDE RANGE OF SUBJECTS".
newsitem.headline: SAKAKIBARA SAYS DISCUSSED "WIDE RANGE OF SUBJECTS".

text.p: Japan's Vice Finance Minister for International Affairs Eisuke Sakakibara said on Wednesday he had discussed a wide range of topics with U.S. Deputy Treasury Secretary Lawrence Summers during a short visit to Washington.
"We have discussed a wide range of subjects including the U.S. economy and the Japanese economy and our monetary cooperation with emerging markets," Sakakibara told reporters after the meeting.
"Japan's policy has not changed," he added without elaborating further.
Treasury earlier on Wednesday said in a statement Summers and Sakakibara had discussed exchange rates during their brief meeting, but made no changes in current policy.
